fields.FIR_Description: On 2026-04-08 at approximately 11:30, it was reported that a loan agent collected Rs. 8,00,000 from the complainant for approving a personal loan and then stopped answering calls. A further person, Harish Murugan, a co-worker, using the number 9000000180, is stated to be associated with the incident. A person named Karthik Shankar, associated with the number 9000000306, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. Funds were reportedly sent to the account reference SYN-ACC-100037. Praveen Balan (9000000446) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. Items referenced in the complaint: digital documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Agent reportedly claimed a guaranteed approval and became unreachable.
